mandate.purpose: monthly fuel and vehicle top-up budget

rationale: Velocity ratio is constructed to land exactly at the elevated/critical boundary (2.0) -- one slightly larger purchase would tip this into 'critical', while a slightly smaller one would drop it comfortably into 'elevated'. Category shift is not part of the ambiguity here (all spend stays in-mandate). Genuinely too close to a threshold edge to confidently call legitimate or drift by a human standard (LABELING_RUBRIC.md: boundary cases are strong abstain_expected candidates).
